body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.38 (naive base rate 0.35) that: AMD Q4 2026 revenue is ≥$17.51B (above the top of its ~$17B ±3% guide). Evidence: 8-K 3-Nov-2026: Q3 2026 revenue record $13.4B (+45% YoY), 'exceeding the high end of our guidance'; Data Center nearly doubled. Q4 guide ~$17B ±3% (midpoint +66% YoY, +27% QoQ), non-GAAP GM ~55%. SEC XBRL quarterly revenue: $10.25B, $11.54B, $13.38B (Q1–Q3 2026). Reasoning: A +27% sequential guide already embeds a big MI-series ramp; beating the top needs supply upside on top of that. AMD's beat-the-top frequency is lower than NVIDIA's. Resolution: YES if AMD's reported Q4 2026 revenue (8-K earnings release) ≥ $17.51B. Source: AMD Q4 2026 earnings 8-K (SEC EDGAR, CIK 2488). Resolve by 2027-02-20; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Large-cap semis beat the top of their own quarterly revenue range roughly a third of the time.
data.resolution_rule: YES if AMD's reported Q4 2026 revenue (8-K earnings release) ≥ $17.51B.

title: Paper call: AMD Q4 2026 revenue is ≥$17.51B (above the top of its ~$17B ±3% guide)
